/bin/bash -lc "python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ye-janaza-hai-hsn-ka-shahzadh-amn-ka.md')
s = p.read_text()
s = s.replace('laadlle', 'laadle')
p.write_text(s)
_, header, body = s.split('---', 2)
roman = header.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(verse):
    return [block.splitlines() for block in verse.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
r, u = blocks(roman), blocks(body)
assert [len(b) for b in r] == [len(b) for b in u]
assert [int(b[0]) for b in r[1:]] == [int(b[0]) for b in u[1:]] == list(range(1, 8))
assert all(c.isascii() or c in 'ṅṄ' for c in roman)
assert all(not line or line.startswith('  ') for line in roman.splitlines())
print('Verified two opening verses and seven corresponding numbered stanzas.')
PY
git diff --check -- src/data/lyrics/ye-janaza-hai-hsn-ka-shahzadh-amn-ka.md"

from pathlib import Path
import subprocess
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/ye-janaza-hai-hsn-ka-shahzadh-amn-ka.md')
s = p.read_bytes().replace(b'laadlle', b'laadle')
p.write_bytes(s)
old = subprocess.check_output(['git', 'show', f'HEAD:{p}'])
_, h, body = s.decode().split('---', 2)
_, old_h, old_body = old.decode().split('---', 2)
prefix, r = h.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)
assert (prefix, body) == (old_h, old_body)
def shape(v):
    return [len(b.splitlines()) for b in v.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
assert shape(r) == shape(body) == [2, 2, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4, 4]
assert [l.strip() for l in r.splitlines() if l.strip().isdigit()] == list('1234567')
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for c in r)
PY
